race.comment: JACKPOT PARK (2) could not have been more impressive at the first run for the new camp, winning dominantly as a warm favourite. Treated well at the barrier draw so no reason he can't back it up. WHISKEY JOE (1) is resuming from a five-month break after finishing fourth at this track and has been gelded. Fitter for placing in a recent Cranbourne trial. Rates a top chance here. SHE WON'T FOLD (7) finished just half a length from the winner in third when fresh from a break last start over 1200m at Mornington after racing on the speed. Tackling a deeper field this time but she is worth serious consideration. JETSETTER JACK (5) lines up for the first time since June 10. Started the last campaign in good style when in the placings over 1100m at this track. Can make his presence felt. NICKIBI (6) turned in a modest performance when fifth last start over 1300m at Bendigo, beaten 13 lengths after a good win on debut at Moe. Nicely placed to figure in the finish.
